documents.name: iQLANDIA
documents.summary: iQLANDIA is a science discovery destination in Liberec, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: One of Czechia’s strongest hands-on science destinations, with dense experimentation and broad school-age appeal.

audience.notes: Editorial destination-fit profile derived from the researched positive age span. Bands without positive evidence remain unknown rather than being treated as a positive match or a hard prohibition. Individual rides and activities may have stricter operator rules.

duration.note: The centre can sustain most of a day for its strongest age range.

coreExperience.note: Many interactives are intuitive, while deeper interpretation uses text or explanation.
Static explanations can be machine-translated when needed.

mobility.note: Indoor science-centre circulation is generally practical.

documents.name: Mirakulum
documents.summary: Mirakulum is a children adventure destination in Milovice, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A huge imaginative outdoor play-and-exploration park with tunnels, climbing structures, water play and enough scale for a full family day.

audience.notes: Editorial destination-fit profile derived from the researched positive age span. Bands without positive evidence remain unknown rather than being treated as a positive match or a hard prohibition. Individual rides and activities may have stricter operator rules.

booking.note: Check current ticketing and peak-day guidance.

duration.note: A full-day visit is realistic for the target age range.

coreExperience.note: Translation is rarely needed for the physical play experience.

mobility.note: A stroller helps between zones but cannot enter most defining play structures.

weather.label: Outdoor, wet and muddy play
weather.note: Water areas and natural surfaces are part of the core experience.

documents.name: Techmania Science Center
documents.summary: Techmania Science Center is a science discovery destination in Plzeň, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A substantial interactive science centre in a former industrial complex with strong physical experimentation.

audience.notes: Editorial destination-fit profile derived from the researched positive age span. Bands without positive evidence remain unknown rather than being treated as a positive match or a hard prohibition. Individual rides and activities may have stricter operator rules.

booking.note: Check current planetarium and programme scheduling separately.

duration.note: Four to seven hours is realistic when combining main galleries, demonstrations and planetarium content.

coreExperience.note: Hands-on exhibits are partly intuitive; live explanations and deeper interpretation use Czech.
Static interpretation can be machine-translated; live demonstrations lose more.

mobility.note: The main visitor areas are practical for family circulation.
